title: George Thomas and the origins of boogie woogie
summary: They discuss boogie-woogie bass and who originated it, with Manetta naming a pianist called Boyman Ham, and Albert Ammons.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered
